<!-- Use type(scope): description for the PR title. Follow CONTRIBUTING.md.
     Keep sections relevant to the change. Remove unused prompts and replace
     placeholders before publishing. Never mark unrun checks as passed. -->

## Summary

<!-- Explain the concrete problem, who it affects, and why this change helps.
     Describe the resulting behavior and any behavior that must stay intact. -->

## Linked issue

<!-- Link related issues. Use Closes #N only if this PR resolves that issue.
     Remove this section when no issue applies. -->

## What users will see

<!-- Describe the workflow and where users discover the change, including
     changed defaults or shortcuts. For internal changes, state that here. -->

## Affected areas

<!-- Select applicable areas so reviewers can follow the impact. A selected
     area describes scope, not proof that verification passed. -->

- [ ] Editor UI, navigation, or keyboard controls
- [ ] Document schema, migration, assets, or native backup format
- [ ] Commands, rendering, layout, or undo/redo
- [ ] MCP tools, targets, revisions, or capabilities
- [ ] Saving, recovery, or concurrent editing
- [ ] Import, export, fonts, or visual fidelity
- [ ] Runtime, release, dependencies, or default access behavior
- [ ] Contributor tooling or documentation

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- Follow docs/feature-delivery.md. List requested outcomes with observed
     results and evidence, or mark them unmet/unverified. Explain affected
     paths omitted from scope. For docs-only work, state the guidance change.
     A known limitation does not close an unmet requirement. -->

## Reproduction

<!-- For a bug fix, give the starting state, steps, and expected versus actual
     behavior before the fix. Describe the observed result after the fix.
     Link an existing check when relevant. Do not add new test files unless
     explicitly requested. Remove this section when it does not apply. -->

## Screenshots

<!-- Required for visible UI changes. Use the repository screenshot skill at
     .agents/skills/attach-screenshot-to-pr/SKILL.md with your own credentials
     as described in docs/contributor-skills.md. Include the entry point and
     labeled Before/After images with descriptive alt text. Compare the same
     content, state, and viewport; include narrow views where affected. Keep
     evidence images outside Git and inspect for sensitive data. Verify the
     published image URLs. Report missing evidence or upload blockers.
     Remove this section or mark it not applicable for nonvisual changes. -->

## Verification

<!-- Name exact relevant commands and observed outcomes, plus real browser/MCP
     journeys. Behavior changes require npm run check and npm run build.
     Docs-only changes need diff/link checks unless CI requires more.
     Name unrun or failed checks that affect confidence. Keep incidental
     machine logs and the complete private validation ledger out of this PR. -->

## Docs and limits

<!-- Link updated product, controls, architecture, format, or runtime contracts.
     State remaining limitations and compatibility or recovery implications.
     If docs did not change, explain why. Name any follow-up work without
     presenting this PR as complete when acceptance criteria remain unmet. -->
